what: It is a Hong Kong firm that links brands with online influencers and runs online ad campaigns aimed at people aged 14 to 35.
proceeds: It plans to use about 40% to grow its business and customer base, 30% to buy more online media resources, and 30% for working capital and general costs.
risks: Clients can stop buying its services at any time with no notice, because most contracts are short-term.
Its business could suffer if it loses its relationships with media channel partners and influencer agencies.
It relies on influencer agencies and their influencers to deliver ads, and it does not directly control the influencers.
It relies on media channel partners and their platforms to deliver ads and give accurate performance data.
It partly depends on contractors for the work of its Hong Kong operating subsidiary.
risks_note: The first 5 risk factors, summarised by AI.
